notes:
Quick CRM notes:
- Source: inbound from enablement partner (sales enablement app integration).
- Primary contact: Priya Nambiar (Head of Product). Wants a self-serve path but needs clear PII/retention answers before encouraging org to onboard.
- Use-case: attach short summary + action items to CRM records after sales calls (~1-3 min summaries). Also sentiment flags, and persistent searchable notes for reps.
- Volume: currently 50-150 calls/week across early beta customers; expect 300-500 by Q3 if conversion picks up.
- Latency target: median <= 250ms for 1-2 paragraph summary; absolute <1s preferred.
- Cost sensitivity: high. SMB budget — "keep below $0.01/call-equivalent" for summaries if possible.
- Model preference: open to Llama-family or other efficiency-focused models; wants Redwood catalog suggestions + recommended quantization.
- Routing/fallback: hosted primary; want automated fallback to smaller/cheaper model when load spikes or for low-value calls.
- Security: must detect and redact PII (emails, CC numbers) before storing. Asking for sample redaction reports and false-positive/negative rates.
- Retention: asking for TTL controls per-customer and per-field (e.g., redact PII immediately, keep non-PII notes 90 days). Legal requires ability to purge on request.
- Quote from call: "We need a button we can trust — if we push summaries to CRM we cannot leak customer SSNs or CCs."
- POC ask: 2-week hosted API POC. Deliverables: sample redaction metrics, retention TTL demo, cost projection for 3mo run at current volumes, performance numbers (p95 latency).
- Technical notes from SE: Diego will drop an example webhook payload; priya will provide 10 anonymized transcripts for redaction tuning.
- Risks: Legal signoff could delay by 3-4 weeks; no current KMS for envelope encryption; unclear how to represent retention controls in their DB.
- Next step (short): send hosted-api quickstart + retention SLA + redaction sample script. Book POC kickoff (30 min) for week of 2026-03-15.
- Internal: potential early play for "Optimize" later if batching suggestions reduce token costs.
